metadata.description: Registry of every Knowledge Compiler artifact type (Sprint 2B).

artifacts.name: Knowledge Record JSON
artifacts.description: Compiled Knowledge Record JSON conforming to the base knowledge record schema (and module overlays when authorized).

artifacts.name: Knowledge Graph
artifacts.description: Graph edges/nodes derived from Knowledge Record relationships and cross-module links.

artifacts.name: Dependency Graph
artifacts.description: Resolved dependency graph among planning IDs / knowledge IDs prior to transform.

artifacts.name: Metadata Index
artifacts.description: Index of record metadata (IDs, status, owner, version, pack/module placement) for discovery and incremental builds.

artifacts.name: Search Index
artifacts.description: Search documents emitted for full-text / faceted discovery of Knowledge Records.

artifacts.name: Validation Report
artifacts.description: Structured validation findings from schema, citation, relationship, and integrity checks.

artifacts.name: Compilation Report
artifacts.description: End-to-end compile report covering mapping, generation, gates, and authorization outcomes.

artifacts.name: Statistics Report
artifacts.description: Run-level or cumulative statistics snapshot conforming to statistics.json model.

artifacts.name: Design Pack Input
artifacts.description: Authorized design pack inputs loaded at STAGE-LOAD.

artifacts.name: Compiler Config Input
artifacts.description: Compiler configuration document.

artifacts.name: Bibliography Registry Input
artifacts.description: Frozen Academic Source bibliography registry.

artifacts.name: Foundation References Input
artifacts.description: Foundation REF-* reference library input.

artifacts.name: Knowledge Schema Input
artifacts.description: Base and module Knowledge Record schemas.

artifacts.name: Citation Rules Input
artifacts.description: Bibliography citation policy configuration.

artifacts.name: Mapping Rules Input
artifacts.description: Design-to-JSON mapping rules for STAGE-TRANSFORM.

artifacts.name: Load Manifest
artifacts.description: Manifest of inputs discovered and loaded during STAGE-LOAD.

artifacts.name: Raw Input Bundle
artifacts.description: Bundled raw inputs prior to parse normalization.

artifacts.name: Parsed Intermediate Representation
artifacts.description: Normalized IR produced by STAGE-PARSE; no academic invention permitted at this stage.

artifacts.name: Record Drafts
artifacts.description: Pre-generation Knowledge Record shaped drafts from STAGE-TRANSFORM.

artifacts.name: Publish Authorization
artifacts.description: Authorization record required before STAGE-PUBLISH writes Official outputs.

artifacts.name: Publish Receipt
artifacts.description: Receipt emitted after a successful Official publish.
